entities.name: Query protein 369 aa
observations: Sequence is 369 aa; estimated molecular mass 40.44 kDa, pI 7.60, GRAVY -0.225, instability index 44.35.

Closest reviewed Swiss-Prot match is RlmN Q7UHU7 at 53.7% identity and 91.9% query coverage; this supports a likely dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase annotation, but it is transferred by homology.

Matched RlmN annotations describe methylation of A2503 in 23S rRNA and A37 in tRNA, with a [4Fe-4S] cluster and SAM-dependent chemistry; these are not direct experimental measurements of the query protein.

entities.name: RlmN Q7UHU7
observations: Reviewed Rhodopirellula baltica RlmN reference homolog; annotated as a dual-specificity methyltransferase targeting A2503 of 23S rRNA and A37 of tRNA; binds a [4Fe-4S] cluster.
